configure
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
dependencies.cmake: FetchContent for Boost, logme, ANTLR (+ jar), range-v3, pugixml, nlohmann_json, inja, alpaca, doctest,
magic_enum, Taskflow, leaf_spy, multi_index_lookup; SaxonC-HE from externals/Saxon
patches: ANTLR, doctest, inja, Saxon cmake

div.div:
what the installer holds
bin/: galimatron, saxonc-he, saxonc-core-he (and the MSVC runtime on Windows)
share/galimatron/xslt/gal-functions.xsl · share/galimatron/catalog.xml (maps the GitHub URL of gal-functions.xsl to that file)
share/doc/galimatron/: LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, third_party_licenses/

div.div:
CI (.github/workflows)
Windows: MSVC Debug, MSVC Release (+ package)
Linux: GCC Debug, GCC Release (+ package), Clang Debug, Clang Release
each: configure → build → run_tests → (package) → upload artifacts

div.div:
release: scripts/release.py copies this repository into the checkout of the public one, minus .cursor/rules, .vscode, the TODO*.txt files, the benchmark's outputs and the build products.
mind: the Saxon core binary is Release-only (a Debug build uses it); the CRT is dynamic; after you add or remove a source file, run CMake again.
